title: The week in pictures: Massive daytime attack on Ukraine, 'No Kings' and France's adieu to Jospin
summary: France held its national tribute to former prime minister Lionel Jospin, Russia launched one of its largest daytime attacks on Ukraine, and protesters across the US and some world capitals held a third round of "No Kings" mass protests against President Donald Trump: here's a look back at the week's most striking images.
